q1_issues.issue: The definite subject "The mist-light" is filled by the bare kind symbol mist_light as Agent of a specific past attracting event, but the Existential section reserves the bare class symbol for non-specific/generic objects and says a definite description picking out a specific thing takes a typed sk_ individual.

"The nightmoths" in the final sentence is resolved to sk_nightmoth_2, the surviving moths that had just fled to and reached the Hollows, rather than to the nightmoths/crowd at the Harbor Row where the threads are said to be left.

q2_gaps: Ordinal day-of-year dating in a non-Gregorian calendar ("on day 300 of Year 1"): (Day <n>) is defined as the calendar day inside a Month, with no convention for a bare day-number of a year.

Bare "together" over a DEFINITE PLURAL that is encoded as a single group witness: Coordination & plurals makes "together" force the collective form for coordinated/plural subjects, but nothing states how it interacts with the group-event + per-member distribution rule that Cardinality / Quantifiers otherwise require for a definite plural with a distributive predicate - i.e. whether "together" suppresses that rule (and, with a group subject, whether it leaves any trace at all).
notes: "at the Harbor Row" in sentence 8 is attached to the crowd NP as (LocatedIn sk_crowd_1 harbor_row) rather than to the hunt event, so the hunt itself gets no location; both attachments are coherent and the parse commits to one without marking the ambiguity. The collective/distributive split is otherwise handled carefully - the two "together" clauses and "gather" stay group-only, while burn / show / descend / hunt / survive / flee / reach / molt / leave each add the per-member rule.
